slot.intent: The memo the night before the raid told staff to shred everything that night.

concept: The memo types out a letter at a time behind a steady caret as each word is spoken; the kicker shrinks to a header before the quote, and a red selection sweeps the order as its last letter lands.
storyboard: 0.0 s, on "The": the kicker types in as the headline, large tracked capitals at the block's left edge, about a letter a frame behind a steady off-white caret, grey settling to off white
Then "memo" at 1.0 s and "said:" at 2.0 s type in beside it at the same even hand, the caret waiting after the last letter between words; THE MEMO SAID is complete at 2.1 s
2.5 s: in flight, the kicker glides upward into a small header above the quote and steps back to mid grey, one smooth move from 2.3 s to 2.95 s, the caret riding its end
3.0 s, on "shred": the caret moves to the quote, which types in large bold JetBrains Mono, the hanging opening mark first, about a letter a frame
4.0 s, on "everything": the next word types in after a space at the same even hand, done by 4.3 s
5.0 s, on "tonight.": the last word types with the closing mark; as it lands at 5.28 s the caret gives way to a flat red selection
5.3 s: the selection sweeps across everything tonight in one smooth stroke, gathering and slowing into the last word as the chapter title's highlight does, landing at 5.63 s
Then a full hold on the header, the quote and its selection to the end; the camera never moves

leansOn.title: Chapter title (this channel's approved version)
leansOn.why: The highlight lands with the last word in one motion, which the owner asked for there.

leansOn.title: Typewriter (the house design)
leansOn.why: Each word types out a letter at a time from the moment it is spoken, and the caret rides the end of the typing.
